title: Event countdown teaser (Canvas)
description: A hype teaser for an event: a kicker pill and the event name slam in over an energetic motif (diagonal stripes, pulsing rings or sliding blocks); a three-band diagonal wipe cuts to a countdown that hits three times, either 3-2-1 (digits slam in with ghost trails, ring bursts and confetti while the ground swaps colour) or a slot-machine 'N days to go' roll that locks on the stated number; a second wipe reveals the poster lockup with the date in an accent block, the place with a pin and a call-to-action pill. Any aspect ratio; 9:16 keeps copy inside the platform-safe band.

date.description: Date (and time) as written in the brief, shown in the accent block

place.description: Venue and/or city, or an online location (empty for none)

kicker.description: Short line above the name, set in capitals (empty for none)

cta.description: Call-to-action pill on the final lockup (empty for none)

count.description: Countdown: 3-2-1 slams, or a roll that lands on `days` with `count_label` under it

days.description: Number the days countdown lands on (only with count = days)

count_label.description: Label under the days number, set in capitals (only with count = days)

palette.description: Ground, ink, accent (date block, first count ground) and second accent (CTA, pin, second count ground); text colours are chosen for 4.5:1 contrast

motif.description: Graphic motif kept clear of the copy column

energy.description: Speed of entrances and motif motion (beat times do not change)

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`.
Uses the system's Inter Display / Inter (fonts-inter) when installed, else Helvetica Neue/Arial.
The days roll passes through larger numbers on its way down; only the landed number is held. Use it only with a day count the brief states.
The reveal needs at least 2.5 s after the countdown; the page throws when the duration is too short.
